channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Gloves off, bibs on: Inside the Boxing Crab’s Cajun seafood boil
item.description: A seafood boil typically refers to a meal centered around shellfish, potatoes, and corn, all boiled in a single pot.

item.title: Iran’s internet blackout silences voices at home as diaspora creators fill the void
item.description: That absence has amplified the voices of Iranian American social media creators, who are now explaining the nation’s complicated history.

item.title: ‘Profoundly shocking’ allegations against labor rights icon Cesar Chavez lead to cancellation of celebrations
item.description: The union co-founded by the late labor leader has distanced itself from upcoming events after reports of abuse at his hand.

item.title: Punk Rock Rodeo, Doodle POP, and some Swamp Critters to boot: Live music this week
item.description: As San Diego swings into its long warm season, back come the live shows — check out this week's musical offerings.

item.title: Best of Point Loma: Nominate your favorite businesses
item.description: It’s time for Peninsula Beacon's annual Best of Point Loma contest!

item.title: Developer now trying to sell housing project in Point Loma
item.description: Protect Point Loma president Eric Law said he felt it was telling that the property now for sale, rather than the developer forging ahead.

item.title: Aztecs shift focus to WBIT, set aside regrets over lost chance for NCAA bid
item.description: The Aztecs received an invitation to the NCAA's WBIT and will host UC Irvine Thursday at USD's Jenny Craig Pavilion.

item.title: Old Globe Director Barry Edelstein in final week of Hedda Gabler: ‘Every time, people gasp’
item.description: Henrik Ibsen's play Hedda Gabler about an extraordinary woman living in decidedly ordinary surroundings, starring Katie Holmes in the title role, takes its final curtain call Sunday after being extended due to popular demand.

item.title: Graves acusaciones en contra del líder campesino César Chávez
item.description: En un comunicado dado a conocer este martes, la UFW dijo que dicha organización fue informada de acusaciones “profundamente preocupantes que no concuerdan con sus valores”, por lo que decidieron no participar en ninguna actividad relacionada con el líder campesino.

item.title: Lawson-Remer proposes consumer protection unit to crack down on junk fees, scams
item.description: San Diego County Board Chair Terra Lawson-Remer Tuesday revealed her plan to create a county Consumer Fairness and Public Protection unit to crack down on junk fees, scams and predatory financial practices.
